_doc: Ground truth for the FUZZY fields (audience, value_propositions, tone_of_voice, ...). Keyed by fuzzy field name; a missing key leaves that field UNGRADED (score None), so the 8 STRUCTURAL/SWOT-critical fields (name, category, offerings, pricing, phone, email, languages, locations) still grade from benchmark/urls.json metadata. This file is intentionally minimal (T-2 / D-6): the structural baseline runs without it; the fuzzy fields need human labeling per URL (T-2 W4) before they contribute to the SWOT-critical average. Do NOT fabricate fuzzy expectations — an invented ground truth makes the baseline lie.
